sloka: कंबलानाम् च मुख्यानाम् क्षौमान् कोटि अंबराणि च ।हस्ति अश्व रथ पादातम् दिव्य रूपम् स्वलंकृतम् ॥१-७४-४॥
transliteration: kaṁbalānām ca mukhyānām kṣaumān koṭi aṁbarāṇi ca ।hasti aśva ratha pādātam divya rūpam svalaṁkṛtam ॥1-74-4॥

translations.english: The king of Mithila and father of the brides gave a hundred thousand cows, excellent woollen carpets, crores of silk garments, four divisions of elephants, horses, chariots and infantry and welldecorated, excellent male and maidservants shining in celestial beauty.
